title: Set ECall Operating Mode Request
description: Backs taf_ecall_ForceOnlyMode/ForcePersistentOnlyMode (mode=ECALL_ONLY), taf_ecall_ExitOnlyMode (mode=NORMAL) -> IPhone::setECallOperatingMode(). Mode names are telux::tel::ECallMode verbatim. Mirrors PhoneManagerServerImpl::SetECallOperatingMode / SetECallOperatingModeRequest.
